###################################################################################################
#  mod-coa-mythic-plus
#
#  Mythic+ keystone runs in Ascension's own protocol, so the client's Mythic+ tracker, timer,
#  banner and keystone socket work unchanged. Time limits, enemy forces totals, required
#  encounters, keystones and scaling come from the client tables in DataDir/dbc
#  (TimedDungeons, MythicKeystones, MythicPlusScaling).
###################################################################################################

[worldserver]

#    MythicPlus.Enable
#        Description: Turn keystone runs on or off.
#        Default:     1

MythicPlus.Enable = 1

#    MythicPlus.RequiredDifficulty
#        Description: Dungeon difficulty a keystone can be started on (0 Normal, 1 Heroic,
#                     2 Mythic). -1 allows any, for testing.
#        Default:     2

MythicPlus.RequiredDifficulty = 2

#    MythicPlus.AllowInDungeonFinder
#        Description: Whether a Dungeon Finder group can start a keystone. Keystones are meant for
#                     groups that enter on their own; on for now, to test the wing start points.
#        Default:     1

MythicPlus.AllowInDungeonFinder = 1

#    MythicPlus.Champion.MinLevel
#        Description: Keystone level from which a Mythic Champion walks every path set with
#                     .mythic setchampionpos (coa_mythic_champion_path).
#        Default:     14

MythicPlus.Champion.MinLevel = 14

#    MythicPlus.Champion.Required
#    MythicPlus.Champion.RequiredCount
#        Description: Whether a key from Champion.MinLevel on needs champions killed to finish, and how many
#                     (at most as many as the dungeon has paths). The tracker shows "Defeat Champions" with it.
#        Default:     1, 1

MythicPlus.Champion.Required = 1
MythicPlus.Champion.RequiredCount = 1

#    MythicPlus.Champion.HealthTrashFactor
#        Description: A champion's health as a multiple of the median elite trash health of the instance.
#        Default:     10

MythicPlus.Champion.HealthTrashFactor = 10

#    MythicPlus.Week
#        Description: Affix week (0-52) for new runs, for testing. -1 follows the calendar
#                     (day of the year / 7), the week the client shows.
#        Default:     -1

MythicPlus.Week = -1

#    MythicPlus.MaxExpansion
#        Description: New keys only point at dungeons up to this expansion (0 Classic, 1 TBC,
#                     2 WotLK).
#        Default:     0

MythicPlus.MaxExpansion = 0

#    MythicPlus.FirstKey.Enable
#    MythicPlus.FirstKey.Difficulty
#        Description: The final boss of a dungeon on this difficulty gives every player without
#                     a keystone a random +1 key.
#        Default:     1, 2

MythicPlus.FirstKey.Enable = 1
MythicPlus.FirstKey.Difficulty = 2

#    MythicPlus.DefaultForces.Normal
#    MythicPlus.DefaultForces.Elite
#        Description: Enemy forces for a creature that has no row in coa_mythic_forces. Only
#                     creatures placed in the database count; summons need a row.
#        Default:     1, 2

MythicPlus.DefaultForces.Normal = 1
MythicPlus.DefaultForces.Elite = 2

#    MythicPlus.NoCreatureLoot
#        Description: Creatures drop no loot during a run.
#        Default:     1

MythicPlus.NoCreatureLoot = 1

#    MythicPlus.CoinItem
#    MythicPlus.CoinItem.TBC
#    MythicPlus.CoinItem.WotLK
#    MythicPlus.CoinsPerLevel
#    MythicPlus.Coins.WeeklyCap
#        Description: Mythic Coins for a finished run: CoinsPerLevel x keystone level, up to WeeklyCap
#                     per character and week (weeks start Tuesday 00:00 UTC). The coin follows the
#                     dungeon's expansion.
#        Default:     1414500, 1414529, 1414530, 50, 5500

MythicPlus.CoinItem = 1414500
MythicPlus.CoinItem.TBC = 1414529
MythicPlus.CoinItem.WotLK = 1414530
MythicPlus.CoinsPerLevel = 50
MythicPlus.Coins.WeeklyCap = 5500

#
#    MythicPlus.Caches.WeeklyCap
#        Description: Mythical Caches a character can open per week.
#        Default:     80

MythicPlus.Caches.WeeklyCap = 80

#
#    MythicPlus.Spoils.MythicDungeonFinderOnly
#        Description: Dungeon Spoils (Mythic) only for groups from the Dungeon Finder. Heroic
#                     Dungeon Spoils come with every finished Heroic vanilla dungeon.
#        Default:     1

MythicPlus.Spoils.MythicDungeonFinderOnly = 1

#
#    MythicPlus.ExcludedDungeons
#        Description: LFG dungeons new keys never point at (space or comma separated).
#        Default:     "2045 2046" (Blackrock Caverns, not restored yet)

MythicPlus.ExcludedDungeons = "2045 2046"

#
#    MythicPlus.Forces.ClearShare
#        Description: Share of a wing's trash that reaches 100 % enemy forces; kills are scaled up
#                     when the wing has less than needed for that. Never scaled down.
#        Default:     0.58

MythicPlus.Forces.ClearShare = 0.58

#    MythicPlus.Forces.WingFactor
#        Description: Per wing, "lfgId:factor" pairs (space separated) multiplied onto each kill's forces
#                     after ClearShare, for wings live videos show differently.
#                     3320 Shadowfang Keep - Halls of the Damned: 18.63 % up to Rethilgore live, 29.75 % here.
#        Default:     "3320:0.626"

MythicPlus.Forces.WingFactor = "3320:0.626"

#    MythicPlus.Health.Basis
#    MythicPlus.Health.Offset
#        Description: Creature health on a key, relative to Mythic:
#                     +1 keeps the Mythic health, from +2 on
#                     Basis x (1 + health % of MythicPlusScaling.dbc) + Offset.
#                     Fitted to videos and combat logs of the live server.
#        Default:     1.1245, -0.02

MythicPlus.Health.Basis = 1.1245
MythicPlus.Health.Offset = -0.02

#    MythicPlus.BossCastLog
#        Description: Write every spell a boss of a vanilla dungeon casts on Heroic or Mythic once per
#                     instance to Server.log (BOSSCAST / BOSSKILL lines) for the mechanics check.
#        Default:     1

MythicPlus.BossCastLog = 1
#
#    MythicPlus.DisabledAffixes
#    MythicPlus.AffixSubstitutes
#        Description: Affixes left out of every week (MythicAffixes.dbc ids, space or comma separated).
#                     Each takes the first substitute its row does not have yet. Empty keeps
#                     Ascension's rotation. The server sends the changed MythicAffixes.dbc rows at
#                     login, so the client shows the same affixes.
#        Default:     "80087" (Tiny), "80046 80044 80026 80024 80032" (Horde, Avenger, Life Stealing,
#                     Fast, True Sight)

MythicPlus.DisabledAffixes = "80087"
MythicPlus.AffixSubstitutes = "80046 80044 80026 80024 80032"
